messages:
Asha Patel: Creating RC candidate build rc-2026-03-20-42. Artifact: s3://redwood-artifacts/rc-2026-03-20-42.tar.gz. Pinning hashes, please review. Promo window tonight 21:00 UTC. @oncall-sre @Olivia Chen @Mike Ross
Deploy Bot: CI: passed (unit, linters). Integration: queued -> running. Security scan: pending. Add release notes link: https://docs/internal/releases/rc-42
Deploy Bot: CI integration: passed. Image built: sha256:abc123def456... Artifact pinned to bucket.
Mike Ross: Thanks. Olivia, can you run the regression smoke set on staging? Need confirmation by 19:30 UTC to hit 21:00 window.
Olivia Chen: Running smoke now. Quick note: flaky test db-connection-timeout observed once, rerunning. Will report within 20m.
Samir Gupta: SRE check: capacity for canary 5% on dedicated pool available. Suggest route: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m with health checks. Also recommend single-region canary (us-west) first.
Asha Patel: Plan: canary in us-west, 10m steady at 5%, 10m at 25%, then full. Rollback policy: immediate rollback to rc-2026-03-19-99 if errors >3% or latency p90 > 300ms.
Eva Lopez: Release notes draft: "improve KV cache management and reduce cold-start latency". I'll publish shortnotes and link.
Olivia Chen: Smoke done: all passes except the earlier flake (now resolved). + load test quick run ok. I sign off for QA. :white_check_mark: 
Deploy Bot: Security scan clear. SCA: 0 high, 2 medium (both dev deps). Vulnerability owner notified.
Mike Ross: Good. @oncall-sre, ok to proceed with pin + promote pre-checks at 20:30 UTC? We'll run final preflight (db migrations dry-run) at 20:40.
oncall-sre: Confirmed. SRE will be on standby 20:30-22:00. I'll watch alerts and evict if needed.
Asha Patel: Executing pin: `aws s3api put-object --bucket redwood-artifacts --key pinned/rc-latest --body rc-2026-03-20-42.tar.gz --metadata build=rc-2026-03-20-42`
Deploy Bot: Pin recorded. Promotion ready. To promote run:
```
/deploy promote --artifact rc-2026-03-20-42 --env prod --strategy phased --phases 5,25,100 --health-threshold 99.5
```
Mike Ross: I'll run the promote at 21:02 UTC (after DB dry-run at 20:40). Rollback command:
```
/deploy rollback --to rc-2026-03-19-99 --reason "automated rollback criteria met"
```
Asha Patel: Noted. Team on standby. If anything abnormal, call the rollback and tag me and @Samir Gupta.
Eva Lopez: Release note link: https://docs/internal/releases/rc-42-notes (short summary + migration note)
Samir Gupta: FYI we've scheduled autoscaler cooldown to 10m during rollout. Also temporarily disable cheap-region fallback to avoid cross-region failovers.
Mike Ross: Promote executed at 21:02 UTC. Deploy Bot: starting phased rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
Deploy Bot: 5% canary healthy (5/5 checks green). Latency p95 within baseline. Advancing to 25% after 10m.
Deploy Bot: 25% healthy. No errors. Advancing to 100%.
Deploy Bot: 100% promoted. All health checks green. Notes: final commit sha abc123def456..., rollout complete.
Asha Patel: Thanks everyone. Post-deploy follow-up: monitor traces for 2 hours. I'll open post-deploy checklist and link to incident channel if anything pops.
Olivia Chen: I'll run targeted evals against key prompt set and report any quality regressions.
Mike Ross: Closing this thread. Tagging release notes and changelog. :rocket:
